price_limits.summary: Across the 20 versions, input prices run from $0.1 to $2 per million tokens and output prices from $0.4 to $12. Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite is the cheapest, at $0.1 per million input tokens and $0.4 per million output tokens. Gemini 3.8 Flash has the largest context window, 1,048,576 tokens.

family_reading.text: Google Gemini is an API only family, so there are no open weights to download or self host. Across all 20 versions, 19 support reasoning and none publish open weights. Context windows range from 32768 to 1048576 tokens, and inputs can include audio, image, text and video, with image and text outputs. The line spans cheap Lite tiers, mid priced Flash tiers and costlier Pro and image focused versions, so pricing varies widely, from $0.1 per million input tokens up to $12 per million output tokens. This suits long document, audio and video work, plus image generation, where a large context and reasoning matter. Limits are the API only access, the highest Pro and image output prices, and the smaller context and output caps on some image models.
